title: The Hedge Witch
text: A witch in a hut on chicken legs, the legs folded under it like a roosting hen's, smoke curling from the chimney. She leans out of the window, all nose and knuckles. She has a cure for what ails you. Her price is always the same: a lock of hair, freely given.

options.label: The most hurt takes her cure, and pays with a lock of hair, freely given.

outcomes.text: The cure works. She strokes the lock of hair as if it were gold before putting it somewhere safe, and afterward they wonder what she will do with it.

options.label: Trade for a potion instead, and keep your hair your own.

outcomes.text: The potion is foul-tasting and strong.

options.label: Leave before the hut stands up. Nothing on chicken legs is to be trusted.

outcomes.text: It stands up anyway to watch you go. The witch throws a pinch of something after you that sets every eye streaming.
